hook_stat.sub: Profit after tax rose to Rs 3,699.59 crore in the quarter

stats.label: Rise in consolidated EBITDA, to Rs 10,665 crore
India EBITDA margin in the quarter

diaspora_bullets: India was the strongest market — Rs 42,653 crore of revenue in the quarter
In the UK, Tata Steel reported an EBITDA loss of 56 million pounds
news_summary: Tata Steel's consolidated profit after tax for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 rose 16.2% year on year to Rs 3,699.59 crore, on revenue up 11.5%.
payoff: India carried the quarter, with India EBITDA of Rs 10,634 crore at a margin of 25%.
